scope: Gmail compose window, expandable recipients, More options and draft print view

reference.inspection: Chrome CUA: opened and closed an empty compose without typing, sending, or changing pre-existing mail. Inspected window controls and More options.

desktop_and_390px: Minimize and restore retain draft content; title tracks edits and replies.
Default fullscreen persists through save, reload and reopen.
Cc/Bcc expansion, visible recipient labels and populated fields survive reopen.
More menu stays within viewport; arrows, End and Escape work; outside click dismisses it.
Plain-text checkbox and disabled formatting state survive reload.
Rich send preserves HTML, CID image identity, image bytes and binary attachment bytes.
Plain draft remains text/plain with exact To/Cc/Bcc and Unicode body.
Protected message and account settings remain exactly unchanged.
checks.print_view: AX inspection contains only draft subject, From/To/Cc/Bcc, body, inline image and attachment names; no inbox content.

limits: The native Chrome print dialog and afterprint cleanup remain unverified because the Mac was locked; no print job was submitted.
CI, deployment and hosted validation of this follow-up remain pending.
Spell check, compose labels, pop-out windows, scheduling, image/Drive pickers, confidential mode and AI compose flows remain open.
This is not full Gmail visual or feature parity.
